record.question: If a patient is admitted and discharged on the same day, the service rendered is _______ in the inpatient service for that day.
record.explanation: Answer A: Added. Under the conventional inpatient service-day rule, the admission day is counted and the discharge day is not, so same-day admission/discharge contributes one inpatient service day. Source/context note: Uses conventional midnight-census service-day counting; local reporting specifications govern. Reference: https://www.ahima.org/media/1pbnus5z/ahima-guidelines-for-achieving-a-compliant-query-practice-2022-update.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
